title: Three remarks on TAOCP Pre-Fascicle 8A: exercises 157(b), 204(b) and 205
scope: An explanation of answer 157(b) (8x8 and every n >= 7), a correction to answer 204(b), and the case n = 1 of problem 205.
gate_basis: notes8a_check.py (Python standard library): the two structural facts for 7 <= n <= 20; the loop of 204(b) as printed and corrected (trie204.py); the exact formula of 205 against the brute-force average over all keys for q <= 9 and its expansion (one_key.py). CP-SAT computations for 157 in search/.
dependencies: Python 3.8+ standard library for notes8a_check.py, trie204.py, one_key.py.
limitations: Not externally peer reviewed and no separate AI referee pass; checks by the stand-alone program (structural facts, literal simulation, brute-force averages for q <= 9).
The letters of the classes in 157 were read from the figure of the draft; the argument itself only uses the orbits of moves.
In 205 only the case of one key is treated; the sqrt q constant is a standard Laplace estimate checked numerically to q = 6400, while the first three terms follow rigorously from the exact formula.
Knuth's draft is cited, not reproduced; exercise numbers are those of the draft of 8 May 2026.
